shortDescription: Coinglass data shows that if ETH falls below $2,353, cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges could reach $1.077 billion. According to ChainCatcher, if ETH rises above $2,587, cumulative short liquidations across major centralized exchanges could reach $568 million.
